crossRefs.note: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…
Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
The king said to me, “Why is your face sad, since you are not sick? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart.” Then I…
“Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
so that on the contrary you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed…
For godly sorrow produces repentance to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

translations.web: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
translations.bsb: A joyful heart makes a cheerful countenance, but sorrow of the heart crushes the spirit.
translations.kjv: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
translations.asv: A glad heart maketh a cheerful countenance; But by sorrow of heart the spirit is broken.
